{
  "name": "max-booster",
  "productName": "Max Booster",
  "version": "3.0.0",
  "description": "AI-Powered Music Career Management Platform",
  "author": {
    "name": "B-Lawz Music",
    "email": "blawzmusic@gmail.com"
  },
  "type": "module",
  "license": "MIT",
  "packageManager": "pnpm@11.22.0",
  "main": "electron/main.js",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "bash scripts/start-dev.sh",
    "security-fix": "npx tsx script/security-fix.ts",
    "build": "npx tsx script/build.ts",
    "build:clean": "DEPLOY_CLEAN=1 npx tsx script/build.ts",
    "build:full": "npm run security-fix && npm run build",
    "deploy:build": "npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npx tsx script/security-fix.ts && npx tsx script/build.ts && node script/deploy-clean-binary.mjs",
    "build:deploy": "npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts && node scripts/postinstall.mjs",
    "build:prod": "npx tsx script/build.ts && npm run prune:deploy",
    "prune:deploy": "npm prune --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund",
    "deploy": "npx tsx scripts/deploy.ts",
    "start": "bash start.sh",
    "demo:security": "npx tsx scripts/security-self-healing-demo.ts",
    "postinstall": "SKIP_POSTINSTALL=1 node scripts/postinstall.mjs",
    "check": "tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json",
    "check:server": "tsc -p tsconfig.server.json",
    "check:client": "tsc -p tsconfig.client.json",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "lint": "eslint . --quiet",
    "lint:fix": "eslint . --fix",
    "fix": "eslint . --fix && prettier . --write",
    "audit": "npm audit fix",
    "verify:dependency-upgrades": "node scripts/verify-dependency-upgrades.mjs",
    "verify": "npm run audit && npm run typecheck && npm run fix",
    "db:push": "node scripts/db-push.js",
    "electron:dev": "electron .",
    "electron:build": "electron-builder --projectDir electron",
    "build:desktop": "tsx scripts/build-apps.ts desktop",
    "build:desktop:full": "FORCE_FULL_BUILD=true tsx scripts/build-apps.ts desktop",
    "build:mobile": "tsx scripts/build-apps.ts mobile",
    "build:desktop+mobile": "tsx scripts/build-apps.ts desktop+mobile",
    "build:apps": "tsx scripts/build-apps.ts all",
    "build:version": "tsx scripts/build-apps.ts version",
    "cap:sync": "npx cap sync",
    "cap:ios": "npx cap open ios",
    "cap:android": "npx cap open android",
    "simulate:quick": "tsx server/simulations/runLifecycleSimulation.ts quick",
    "simulate:lifecycle": "tsx server/simulations/runLifecycleSimulation.ts full",
    "simulate:period": "tsx server/simulations/runLifecycleSimulation.ts period",
    "simulate:ad-booster": "tsx server/simulations/runSimulation.ts ad-booster",
    "simulate:auto-upgrade": "tsx server/simulations/runSimulation.ts auto-upgrade",
    "simulate:all": "tsx server/simulations/runSimulation.ts all",
    "test:load": "tsx tests/load/load-test.ts",
    "test:smoke": "tsx tests/smoke/post-deployment-tests.ts",
    "test:security": "tsx scripts/penetration-test.ts",
    "security:audit": "npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high",
    "test:all": "npm run security:audit && npm run test:load && npm run test:security",
    "prelaunch": "tsx scripts/pre-launch-check.ts",
    "check:ports": "tsx scripts/check-port-contract.ts",
    "autofix:deploy": "node scripts/deployment-autofix.mjs",
    "validate:error-research": "node scripts/validate-error-research.mjs",
    "feature-matrix": "node scripts/generate-feature-matrix.mjs",
    "bootstrap:admin": "tsx -e \"import { bootstrapAdmin } from './server/init-admin'; bootstrapAdmin().then(() => process.exit(0)).catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })\"",
    "db:push:force": "node scripts/db-push.js --force",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "test:unit": "vitest run --config vitest.config.ts",
    "test:integration": "vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts",
    "test:integration:ci": "vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts --reporter=verbose --reporter=junit --outputFile=test-results-integration.xml",
    "test:watch": "vitest watch --config vitest.config.ts",
    "test:coverage": "vitest run --coverage --config vitest.config.ts",
    "test:ci": "vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --reporter=junit --outputFile=test-results.xml",
    "gateway": "npx tsx server/diffusion-gateway/index.ts",
    "check:fast": "tsgo -p tsconfig.json --noEmit"
  },
  "build": {
    "appId": "com.blawzmusic.maxbooster",
    "productName": "Max Booster",
    "asar": true,
    "nodeGypRebuild": false,
    "buildDependenciesFromSource": false,
    "files": [
      "electron/**/*",
      "dist/index.mjs",
      "dist/index.cjs",
      "dist/cluster.mjs",
      "dist/public/**/*",
      "!electron/package-lock.json",
      "!node_modules/@tensorflow/**/*",
      "!node_modules/@sentry-internal/node-cpu-profiler/**/*",
      "!**/*.map"
    ],
    "asarUnpack": [
      "dist/index.mjs",
      "dist/index.cjs"
    ],
    "directories": {
      "output": "dist-installers",
      "buildResources": "electron/assets"
    },
    "win": {
      "target": [
        "nsis",
        "portable"
      ],
      "icon": "electron/assets/icon.png"
    },
    "mac": {
      "target": [
        "dmg",
        "zip"
      ],
      "icon": "electron/assets/icon.png",
      "category": "public.app-category.music",
      "hardenedRuntime": true,
      "gatekeeperAssess": false,
      "entitlements": "electron/assets/entitlements.mac.plist",
      "entitlementsInherit": "electron/assets/entitlements.mac.plist",
      "identity": null
    },
    "linux": {
      "target": [
        "AppImage",
        "deb",
        "tar.gz"
      ],
      "icon": "electron/assets/icon.png",
      "category": "Audio",
      "maintainer": "B-Lawz Music <blawzmusic@gmail.com>"
    },
    "nsis": {
      "oneClick": false,
      "allowToChangeInstallationDirectory": true,
      "createDesktopShortcut": true,
      "createStartMenuShortcut": true
    },
    "publish": [
      {
        "provider": "github",
        "owner": "blawzmusic",
        "repo": "max-booster",
        "releaseType": "release"
      }
    ]
  },

    "build:full": "npm run security-fix && npm run build",
    "deploy:build": "npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npx tsx script/security-fix.ts && npx tsx script/build.ts && node script/deploy-clean-binary.mjs",
    "build:deploy": "npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts && node scripts/postinstall.mjs",
    "build:prod": "npx tsx script/build.ts && npm run prune:deploy",
    "prune:deploy": "npm prune --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund",
    "deploy": "npx tsx scripts/deploy.ts",
    "start": "bash start.sh",
    "demo:security": "npx tsx scripts/security-self-healing-demo.ts",
    "postinstall": "SKIP_POSTINSTALL=1 node scripts/postinstall.mjs",
    "check": "tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json",
    "check:server": "tsc -p tsconfig.server.json",
    "check:client": "tsc -p tsconfig.client.json",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "lint": "eslint . --quiet",
    "lint:fix": "eslint . --fix",
    "fix": "eslint . --fix && prettier . --write",
    "audit": "npm audit fix",
    "verify:dependency-upgrades": "node scripts/verify-dependency-upgrades.mjs",
    "verify": "npm run audit && npm run typecheck && npm run fix",
    "db:push": "node scripts/db-push.js",
    "electron:dev": "electron .",
    "electron:build": "electron-builder --projectDir electron",
    "build:desktop": "tsx scripts/build-apps.ts desktop",
    "build:desktop:full": "FORCE_FULL_BUILD=true tsx scripts/build-apps.ts desktop",
    "build:mobile": "tsx scripts/build-apps.ts mobile",
    "build:desktop+mobile": "tsx scripts/build-apps.ts desktop+mobile",
    "build:apps": "tsx scripts/build-apps.ts all",
    "build:version": "tsx scripts/build-apps.ts version",
    "cap:sync": "npx cap sync",
    "cap:ios": "npx cap open ios",
    "cap:android": "npx cap open android",
    "simulate:quick": "tsx server/simulations/runLifecycleSimulation.ts quick",
    "simulate:lifecycle": "tsx server/simulations/runLifecycleSimulation.ts full",
    "simulate:period": "tsx server/simulations/runLifecycleSimulation.ts period",
    "simulate:ad-booster": "tsx server/simulations/runSimulation.ts ad-booster",
    "simulate:auto-upgrade": "tsx server/simulations/runSimulation.ts auto-upgrade",
    "simulate:all": "tsx server/simulations/runSimulation.ts all",
    "test:load": "tsx tests/load/load-test.ts",
    "test:smoke": "tsx tests/smoke/post-deployment-tests.ts",
    "test:security": "tsx scripts/penetration-test.ts",
    "security:audit": "npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high",
    "test:all": "npm run security:audit && npm run test:load && npm run test:security",
    "prelaunch": "tsx scripts/pre-launch-check.ts",
    "check:ports": "tsx scripts/check-port-contract.ts",
    "autofix:deploy": "node scripts/deployment-autofix.mjs",
    "validate:error-research": "node scripts/validate-error-research.mjs",
    "feature-matrix": "node scripts/generate-feature-matrix.mjs",
    "bootstrap:admin": "tsx -e \"import { bootstrapAdmin } from './server/init-admin'; bootstrapAdmin().then(() => process.exit(0)).catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })\"",
    "db:push:force": "node scripts/db-push.js --force",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "test:unit": "vitest run --config vitest.config.ts",
    "test:integration": "vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts",
    "test:integration:ci": "vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts --reporter=verbose --reporter=junit --outputFile=test-results-integration.xml",
    "test:watch": "vitest watch --config vitest.config.ts",
    "test:coverage": "vitest run --coverage --config vitest.config.ts",
    "test:ci": "vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --reporter=junit --outputFile=test-results.xml",
    "gateway": "npx tsx server/diffusion-gateway/index.ts",
    "check:fast": "tsgo -p tsconfig.json --noEmit"

[project]
name = "repl-nix-workspace"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Add your description here"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
# Dependencies intentionally empty — all Python packages needed by the port
# 8008 diffusion server (numpy, fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic, pillow, scipy)
# are installed by build.sh into python_runtime/ using the portable CPython
# binary downloaded from python-build-standalone.
# Keeping this list empty ensures `uv sync` is a true no-op and never tries
# to write to the read-only Nix store during the deployment build phase.
dependencies = [
    "anyio>=4.14.2,<5",
    "fastapi>=0.100.0",
    "numpy>=1.24.0",
    "pillow>=12.3.0",
    "pydantic>=2.0.0",
    "scipy>=1.11.0",
    "starlette>=1.3.1",
    "uvicorn[standard]>=0.23.0",
    "volare>=0.20.6",
]

[tool.uv]
# Do not treat this project as an installable package.
# Makes `uv sync` a true no-op (nothing to install, nothing to build).
package = false
